# cmp

Compare two byte streams for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/cmp@0.2.5 [-b] [-s|-l] [-n LIMIT] [-i SKIP[:SKIP2]] FILE1 [FILE2]
```

## Supported scope

Compare files or stdin; omitted FILE2 means stdin. Exit 0 for equal inputs, 1 for differences and 2 for errors.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-s` / `--silent` | none | Report status only; stop at the first difference. |
| `--quiet` | none | Report status only; stop at the first difference. |
| `-l` / `--verbose` | none | List every differing byte. |
| `-b` / `--print-bytes` | none | Show differing byte values. |
| `-n` / `--bytes` | required | Compare at most LIMIT bytes. |
| `-i` / `--ignore-initial` | required | Skip initial bytes independently. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- -l and -s cannot be combined.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/cmp@0.2.5 first.bin second.bin
moonx cli/cmp@0.2.5 -n 16 first.bin second.bin
```
